## Headline statement

**This is not a full reproduction of the paper's results.** We built
faithful, from-scratch implementations of both entropy metrics (H, SE) and
validated them exactly against the paper's own worked example. We
qualitatively confirmed H/SE behavior on the 8 publicly available short WAV
clips (where present in `data/raw/` at generation time). We did **not**
reproduce the paper's headline >95% detection accuracy figures or Pearson
correlations, because those require long-duration recordings and manual
annotation vectors that are not available in this environment (see
`docs/reproduction_audit.md` and `docs/author_correspondence.md`).

## What was reproduced

- Permutation entropy (H), computed from scratch per Eqs. (1)-(4),
  reproduces the paper's own worked example exactly: `(7,3,4,5)->(3,0,1,2)`,
  `(3,4,5,2)->(1,2,3,0)`.
- Sample entropy (SE), computed from scratch per Eqs. (5)-(12), matches an
  independent brute-force cross-check exactly.
- Synthetic sanity-ordering checks for both metrics (see
  `docs/reproduction_audit.md`).
- The full long-duration detrend/threshold/count pipeline and the
  confusion-matrix/accuracy pipeline, both validated end-to-end against
  synthetic placeholder data with known ground truth.
